findings.PDFEdition: Physical page 20 visibly re-inspected: 2026–27 heading, blue restricted-choice cells, navy 30-EC open space and zero-EC seminars agree with extraction. No material hidden/visible edition conflict.
findings.interestRows: All 84 linked programme-interest rows (42 distinct signals repeated for full/part-time registrations) individually reviewed against official Dutch home/curriculum/future material and adopted OER. 66 retain / 18 correct; PLUS provenance retained without English-route ownership or invented UCR specialist implementation; outcomes search-only.
findings.CP119Comparability: Each alternative has six dedicated philosophical courses / 45 EC, including political philosophy, plus legal-philosophical Human Rights, logical reasoning and rhetoric. Philosophy is an object and method of sustained inquiry (ethics, mind, emotion, agency, political thought), not merely a generic theme. All 31 actual enriched profiles and weights inspected. Historical/literary/rhetorical interpretation versus ethical climate/public-decision application differ by seven courses / 52.5 EC on each side. Two qualified alternatives retained; a third theoretical route would repeat the philosophical core or substitute AI/psychology. Theology/religion lacks a supported sustained sequence.
findings.alignmentAndLimitations: Six shared alignments are explicitly partial: Western introduction versus global antiquity; normative ethics; political philosophy; discrete mathematical logic; mind; rhetorical argument. Missing Chinese/Sanskrit breadth, specialist histories, epistemology/philosophy of science/metaphysics, Plato/Kant text seminars and compulsory individual thesis remain gaps. Archaeology, mythology, stylistics, governance and empirical methods are complements, not replacements.
findings.courseConditions: Principally Dutch community interaction for Rhetoric in Action is explicit. Sustainability project is small-team regional research.
